Plugin.Name: Cache / Array Share Control
Plugin.Overview: Gives every user share three explicit, mutually exclusive choices: Cache -> Array (primary on the chosen pool, secondary Array), Cache only (primary on the chosen pool, no secondary), or Array only (runs Mover first, verifies every mounted pool is clear, with an optional Force remaining transfer for stubborn leftovers, before applying the policy). Uses Unraid's native /update.htm share-update interface, creates a timestamped backup before every batch, verifies every applied change, rolls back completed changes if a later share fails, and can restore the most recent un-restored batch. Never runs Mover automatically outside of an Array-only operation.
